arxiv-2108-07681.title: Global well-posedness for fractional Sobolev-Galpern type equations
arxiv-2108-07681.creator: Huy Tuan Nguyen, Nguyen Anh Tuan, Chao Yang
arxiv-2108-07681.description: Abstract This article is a comparative study on an initial-boundary value problem for a class of semilinear pseudo-parabolic equations with the fractional Caputo derivative, also called the fractional Sobolev-Galpern type equations. The purpose of this work is to reveal the influence of the degree of the source nonlinearity on the well-posedness of the solution.

arxiv-2204-01781.title: Constraints on Multi-Field Inflation from the BOSS Galaxy Survey
arxiv-2204-01781.creator: Giovanni Cabass, Mikhail M. Ivanov, Oliver H. E. Philcox, Marko Simonović, Matias Zaldarriaga
arxiv-2204-01781.description: Abstract We use redshift-space galaxy clustering data from the BOSS survey to constrain local primordial non-Gaussianity (LPNG). This is of particular importance due to the consistency relations, which imply that a detection of LPNG would rule out all single-field inflationary models.

arxiv-2303-00450.title: Federated Learning based Hierarchical 3D Indoor Localization

arxiv-2303-00450.description: Abstract The proliferation of connected devices in indoor environments opens the floor to a myriad of indoor applications with positioning services as key enablers. arxiv-2408-00102.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sylvy Anscombe, Dugald Macpherson, Charles Steinhorn and Daniel Wolf. We develop a general framework (multidimensional asymptotic classes, or m.a.c.s) for handling classes of finite first order structures with a strong uniformity condition on cardinalities of definable sets: The condition asserts that definable families given by a formula φ ⁡ ( x ¯ , y ¯ ) \varphi(\bar{x},\bar{y}) should take on a fixed number n φ n_{\varphi} of approximate sizes in any M M in the class, with those sizes varying with M M .

arxiv-2408-05268.title: Proof of principle X-ray reflection mass measurement of the black hole in H1743-322
arxiv-2408-05268.creator: Edward Nathan, Adam Ingram, James F. Steiner, Ole König, Thomas Dauser, Matteo Lucchini, Guglielmo Mastroserio, Michiel van der Klis, Javier A. García, Riley Connors, Erin Kara, Jingyi Wang
arxiv-2408-05268.description: Abstract The black hole X-ray binary H1743-322 lies in a region of the Galaxy with high extinction, and therefore it has not been possible to make a dynamical mass measurement. In this paper we make use of a recent model which uses the X-ray reflection spectrum to constrain the ratio of the black hole mass to the source distance.

arxiv-2408-17137.title: Joining simplified physics models with coarse grids to speed-up intractable 3D time-domain simulations
arxiv-2408-17137.creator: Wouter Deleersnyder 1,2 , Evert Slob 3 1 KU Leuven Campus Kortrijk - KULAK, Department of Physics, Etienne Sabbelaan 53, 8500 Kortrijk, Belgium. 2 Ghent University, Department of Geology, Krijgslaan 281 - S8, 9000 Gent, Belgium E-mail: wouter.deleersnyder@ugent.be 3 Delft University of Technology, F
arxiv-2408-17137.description: Abstract Full 3D modelling of time-domain electromagnetic data requires tremendous computational resources. Consequently, simplified physics models prevail in geophysics, using a much faster but approximate (1D) forward model. We propose to join the accuracy of a 1D simplified physics model with the flexibility of coarse grids to reduce the modelling errors, thereby avoiding the full 3D accurate simulations.

arxiv-2409-06022.title: Existence of ground states for free energies on the hyperbolic space
arxiv-2409-06022.creator: José A. Carrillo, Razvan C. Fetecau, Hansol Park
arxiv-2409-06022.description: Abstract . We investigate a free energy functional that arises in aggregation-diffusion phenomena modelled by nonlocal interactions and local repulsion on the hyperbolic space ℍ n \mathbb{H}^{n} . The free energy consists of two competing terms: an entropy, corresponding to slow nonlinear diffusion, that favours spreading, and an attractive interaction potential energy that favours aggregation.

arxiv-2507-17672.title: Coupling all-electron full-potential density functional theory with grid-based continuum embeddings
arxiv-2507-17672.creator: Jakob Filser, Edan Bainglass, Karsten Reuter, Oliviero Andreussi
arxiv-2507-17672.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jakob Filser, Edan Bainglass, Karsten Reuter, Oliviero Andreussi. Recent advances in continuum embedding models have enabled the incorporation of solvent and electrolyte effects into density functional theory (DFT) simulations of material surfaces, significantly benefiting electrochemistry, catalysis, and other applications. To extend the simulation of diverse systems and properties, the implementation of continuum embedding models into the Environ library adopts a modular programming paradigm, offering a flexible interface for communication with various DFT programs.

arxiv-2508-16856.title: A Workflow for Map Creation in Autonomous Vehicle Simulations
arxiv-2508-16856.creator: Zubair Islam, Ahmaad Ansari, George Daoud, and Mohamed El-Darieby
arxiv-2508-16856.description: Abstract The fast development of technology and artificial intelligence has significantly advanced Autonomous Vehicle (AV) research, emphasizing the need for extensive simulation testing. Accurate and adaptable maps are critical in AV development, serving as the foundation for localization, path planning, and scenario testing.

arxiv-2602-10226.title: Self-Evolving Recommendation System: End-To-End Autonomous Model Optimization With LLM Agents CCS: Information systems Recommender systems CCS: Information systems Language models
arxiv-2602-10226.creator: Haochen Wang, Yi Wu, Daryl Chang, Li Wei, Lukasz Heldt
arxiv-2602-10226.description: Abstract . Optimizing large-scale machine learning systems, such as recommendation models for global video platforms, requires navigating a massive hyperparameter search space and, more critically, designing sophisticated optimizers, architectures, and reward functions to capture nuanced user behaviors. Achieving substantial improvements in these areas is a non-trivial task, traditionally relying on extensive manual iterations to test new hypotheses.

pmc-11472498.creator: Shahryar Rajai Firouzabadi, Ida Mohammadi, Kiana Ghafourian, Seyed Ali Mofidi, Shahrzad Rajaei Firouzabadi, Seyed Mahmoud Hashemi, Fahimeh Ramezani Tehrani, Kyana Jafarabady
pmc-11472498.description: BackgroundPrimary ovarian insufficiency (POI) manifests with hormonal imbalances, menstrual irregularities, follicle loss, and infertility. Mesenchymal stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles (MSC-EVs) are emerging as a promising treatment for POI. This systematic review aims to assess the effects of MSC-EVs on follicle number, hormonal profile, and fertility in POI animal models.

pmc-13304214.title: Interdisciplinary Periodontal and Prosthetic Considerations in a Patient With Amelogenesis Imperfecta: A Case Report
pmc-13304214.creator: Kubra Burcu Yildirim, Gizem Ince Kuka, Hare Gursoy
pmc-13304214.description: Amelogenesis imperfecta (AI) comprises a clinically and genetically heterogeneous group of conditions characterized by enamel hypoplasia and/or hypomineralization, which frequently complicate functional rehabilitation and restorative treatment planning in affected patients. This case report describes the interdisciplinary management of a young male patient diagnosed with amelogenesis imperfecta.

pmc-13561198.creator: Soumar Alziadan, Hilal Alfirzly, Yara Alturkmany Alabead, Amjad Jamil
